_comment: Committed expectations for ControlLoop issue #444 (E18.10), asserted by
the reference-scenario workflow. Every value was produced by a real
`controlloop gate` run against this branch, never hand-written.
The review workflow gains id-token: write and --dangerously-skip-permissions.

authority_statements: This change gives Claude Code the power to run in GitHub Actions workflow `claude-review` with write access to id-token, skipping every permission prompt (`.github/workflows/claude-review.yml`, job `review`). No approval is recorded.
